profile.headline: Control Systems Software Engineer (Thermal), Platform Architecture @Apple | PhD @GATech
profile.jobTitle: Control Systems Software Engineer, Platform Architecture
profile.summary: Experienced Control Systems Software Engineer with 4 years in designing, testing, and developing software-based thermal management solutions, and 5 years of Ph.D. research specializing in optimization and machine learning. I play piano and tennis in my free time.

positions.title: Control Systems Software Engineer, Platform Architecture
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented control algorithms for power and thermal management, including skin temperature regulation and silicon-level thermal protection.
- Developed system identification techniques and predictive models for thermal and power management.
- Contributed to the development of a control system library to streamline design and simulation workflows.
- Participated in test automation and tool development for validating thermal and power management systems.

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Contributed to the Digital RF Battlespace Emulator (DRBE) program, developing a large-scale virtual RF environment for radar and electronic warfare system testing and training.
- Designed radar object scattering models by solving linear/bilinear inverse problems with sparsity constraints.
- Developed low sidelobe antennas using advanced optimization techniques.
- Built optimization and machine learning algorithms in PyTorch and MATLAB to support RF modeling and analysis.

positions.title: Control Systems Engineer Intern, Platform Architecture
positions.description: - Develop system identification and control techniques to model and simulate power/performance/thermal systems of Apple products.

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description:
- Robot arm sensor placements and design troubleshooting
- Robot arm installation, repair, and customer service

company.name: Shini USA, Division of Budzar Industries

projects.title: Digital RF Battlespace Emulator (DRBE)
projects.description:
The Digital RF Battlespace Emulator (DRBE) program aims to create the world’s first, large-scale, virtual RF environment for developing, training, and testing advanced radio frequency (RF) systems. The DRBE system will seek to enable numerous RF systems such as radar and electronic warfare (EW) systems to interact with each other in a fully closed-loop RF environment.

- Design radar object scattering models by solving linear/bilinear inverse problems with sparsity constraints.

projects.title: Eigensystem Realization Algorithm for Linear System Identification (Linear Dynamic Systems and Control Course Project)
projects.description:
- Decompose Hankel matrix to identify a linear system from the impulse responses.
- Explore possibilities to generalize to nonlinear systems or non-impulse response.
